text:
carla: hey all 👋 joined today — quick observability onboarding Qs. I can see some Grafana dashboards but when I try to edit I get a 403. Datadog UI shows "No entitlements" for me, and Sentry doesn't list the project our team uses. who should I ping to get the three of those fixed?

maya: welcome, carla! :wave: for Grafana perms we usually need infra to add you to the grafana-edit group. @ethan (infra) is our go-to. for Datadog that’s an entitlement from the security/okta side (SCIM sync) — open a ticket or I can kick it off. Sentry: add via org team invite, ping whoever owns the project. link to onboarding doc: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/observability/onboarding

joel: quick checklist i usually run: 1) confirm Okta displays you in the right groups 2) try signing out and back in (SSO caches) 3) if grafana 403, paste the dashboard uid here. for datadog, check https://app.datadoghq.com/account/settings?tab=entitlements — if you see nothing, it's an entitlement gap.

carla: thanks — dashboard UID is `RVb8kPj4z` (service-metrics). i tried signout/signin already, still 403.

ethan: hey @carla, i can see you in the read-only grafana group only. i'll add you to `grafana-editors` now. if you still can't edit after a couple mins, try an incognito window. giving me a sec to grant.

devex-bot: Observability onboarding checklist updated. If you want edit access on a specific dashboard include the dashboard UID and the owning team. Docs: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/observability/grafana-permissions 

ethan: done — you should now be in `grafana-editors`. try again and report back.

carla: ok i can now click edit! thanks 🙏 one follow-up: need to add a new panel to service-metrics dashboard, is there an approval process or can editors push?

maya: generally editors can push minor UI changes, but for panels that add new high-cardinality metrics we ask for a quick review in #eng-monitoring. if it touches alerting, file a PR against the dashboard JSON in the repo and add an owner as reviewer.

carla: re datadog — still seeing "No entitlements". any next steps?

joel: @carla if SCIM hasn't synced yet, we open an internal okta request. @maya can you open the ticket? include the user's email and the org groups: `datadog-users` and `datadog-provisioned`. include a note: need logs/rum entitlements.

maya: done, ticket #IT-4921 created and assigned to identity team. ETA 1 business day.

carla: perfect, thanks. last one — Sentry: project not visible. i see the org but not the project list.

sarah: hey @carla i'm the Sentry owner for that project (service-team). i'll invite you to the project in a minute. which email did you sign up with?

carla: carla@redwood.dev (same as okta).

sarah: invite sent. you should get an email; if not i can add via the org UI directly. once accepted you’ll see the project under Projects -> service-team.

carla: got the invite and accepted — can see it now. Datadog ticket pending, grafana fixed, sentry fixed. thanks everyone, this was super smooth :tada:

maya: awesome, welcome again and ping #devex if anything else blocks you.

carla: will do, thanks all!

ethan: leaving a note: if anyone else hits this flow — common fixes are group membership + SSO cache. incognito + wait for SCIM sync usually resolves 80%.

devex-bot: Thread resolved flag set by maya.
